mentions.name: free-grilly backend
mentions.description: This is a backend for the open source free-grilly BBQ thermometer firmware, built for a thermometer product that was discontinued. The repository is currently private and is planned for public release once a GUI is ready; after that, the builders plan to learn PCB design and electronics to possibly design their own BBQ thermometer.
mentions.problem: The commercial BBQ thermometer product it supports was discontinued.
mentions.source_excerpt: A backend for an open source bbq thermometer firmware that a mate and I wrote last year for a product that was discontinued (https://github.com/epiecs/free-grilly).

evidence.value: A backend for an open source bbq thermometer firmware that a mate and I wrote last year for a product that was discontinued (https://github.com/epiecs/free-grilly).
